fact: The Rwanda Statistical Yearbook 2025, published in December 2025 by NISR, compiles statistics drawn from administrative records, with table sources naming the Ministry of Education school census, R-HMIS health facility database and RBC, RSSB (social security), Rwanda National Police, Rwanda Investigation Bureau, Supreme Court, RRA, NAEB, RURA, REG, WASAC, RDB and RTDA.
title: Rwanda Statistical Yearbook 2025
publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
